about: The controller painted for Settings > Controls > Gamepad (2026-10-01). Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5, variant flare, quality medium, 1k, aspect 3:2, background transparent, 0.5 credit each. Style reference: assets/ui/keyboard_controls.png uploaded as image_references (media a3ca2cb8-97a9-4f93-9b05-8feccd96aa62). Prompt: 'Paint a game controller (gamepad) in exactly the art style of the reference image: the same hand-painted dark-fantasy game UI illustration with thick black ink outlines, rough grey brush-stroked stone texture with white dry-brush highlights and ragged chipped edges, and dark charcoal buttons with thin warm copper-bronze rims ... classic Xbox-style layout ... The four face buttons carry engraved bronze capital letters: Y on the top button, B on the right button, A on the bottom button, X on the left button. No other text ... straight-on front view from above ... Isolated on a fully transparent background'. Game copy: alpha 254 rescaled to 255, haze under 6 dropped, tight crop, LANCZOS to 760 px wide, 256-colour palette PNG (122 KB, the full-colour one was 664 KB and looked the same). Only the face buttons are lettered; every word on the tab is real text drawn by renderControls in game.js.

buttons_about: Measured on gamepad_controls.png from the copper rims and the dark button faces: [x %, y %] of the painting, and for the round controls a radius in % of the painting's width. renderControls points its lines at these; tests/controls-tabs.test.cjs checks that every line ends on its button and crosses no other.
